# Shiv Swarodaya — A Concept Map of the Ancient Breath Science

> Shiv Swarodaya is a 396-verse Sanskrit scripture on svara — the science of breath. This site is a navigable concept map showing how all 396 verses connect as one system. It is not a translation; it is a visual architecture of diagrams and tables for the ancient knowledge.

## Overview

- [Home](https://shiv-swarodaya.web.app/): Introduction and navigation guide
- [Overview](https://shiv-swarodaya.web.app/overview): Hub diagram — the full system at a glance

## Spine — Foundation

- [Tattvas](https://shiv-swarodaya.web.app/tattvas): The five elements (earth, water, fire, air, ether)
- [Prana & Vayus](https://shiv-swarodaya.web.app/prana-vayus): The five pranic forces
- [Nadis](https://shiv-swarodaya.web.app/nadis): Ida, Pingala, and Sushumna — the subtle channels
- [Svara](https://shiv-swarodaya.web.app/svara): The active breath and the poorna/shoonya cycle

## Bhukti — Reading the World

- [Prediction Engine](https://shiv-swarodaya.web.app/bhukti-reading-the-world): How the active element is read to interpret events
- [Combat](https://shiv-swarodaya.web.app/bhukti-combat): Svara-based guidance for war and conflict
- [Conception](https://shiv-swarodaya.web.app/bhukti-conception): Breath and conception timing
- [Disease Prognosis](https://shiv-swarodaya.web.app/bhukti-disease-prognosis): Reading illness through breath
- [Lifespan Prognosis](https://shiv-swarodaya.web.app/bhukti-lifespan-prognosis): Death signs and longevity
- [Weather & Agriculture](https://shiv-swarodaya.web.app/bhukti-weather-agriculture): Forecasting through svara

## Mukti — Transforming the Self

- [Yoga Path](https://shiv-swarodaya.web.app/mukti-yoga): Pranayama, Sushumna awakening, and liberation

## Synthesis

- [Unifying View](https://shiv-swarodaya.web.app/unifying-view): How all branches connect to one root
- [Glossary](https://shiv-swarodaya.web.app/glossary): Key Sanskrit terms explained
